tools: the project's Maven wrapper (./mvnw, Maven 3.9.3, wrapper 3.2.0)
commands: cd src && PATH="$(printf %s "$PATH" | tr : '\n' | grep -vxE '/(usr/)?sbin' | paste -sd : -)" MAVEN_OPTS=-Xmx2g ./mvnw -B -pl iidm/iidm-criteria -am -DskipTests clean package
notes: projectVersion at this commit: 6.8.0-SNAPSHOT. Reactor of -pl iidm/iidm-criteria -am: powsybl (root pom), commons-test, commons, computation, tools, tools-test, computation-local, math, iidm, iidm-api, config-test, iidm-criteria; commons-test, tools-test and config-test are test-scope only and not used. The seven jars are the powsybl-core modules on the runtime class path of powsybl-iidm-criteria. PATH without /sbin and /usr/sbin: mvnw checks its downloaded wrapper jar with `sha256sum -c` reading stdin when sha256sum is on PATH; the /sbin/sha256sum of recent macOS does not accept that, so mvnw would stop ('Failed to validate Maven wrapper SHA-256'); without it mvnw falls back to shasum (on Linux sha256sum is in /usr/bin and is used). PowsyblCoreVersion: powsybl-tools fills the template PowsyblCoreVersion.java with the build time that buildnumber-maven-plugin stores in the property timestamp (current time in ms, no reproducible-build option; it is the only use of the property), so com/powsybl/tools/PowsyblCoreVersion.class differs on every build. It is left out of the comparison (classes_exclude); the other 34 classes of powsybl-tools and all classes of the other six jars are compared as usual. The only com.powsybl artifacts fetched are the parent pom and powsybl-build-tools of the separate powsybl-parent project. Fixed: the evaluation's fixed class path replaces only powsybl-iidm-criteria (by the patched 6.7.2 release, which holds RegexCriterion); the other six modules stay at the vulnerable commit's build.
